panels.title: Concurrent Chatters
panels.description: Distinct chatters who posted in different selected channels within the overlap window.

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT
    event_time,
    channel_name,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), 'name:' || LOWER(NULLIF(user_name, ''))) AS chatter_key
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), NULLIF(user_name, '')) IS NOT NULL
), concurrent AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.chatter_key
  FROM scoped a
  JOIN scoped b
    ON b.chatter_key = a.chatter_key
   AND b.channel_name <> a.channel_name
   AND b.event_time >= a.event_time
   AND b.event_time <= a.event_time + INTERVAL '${overlap_minutes} minutes'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Concurrent chatters"
FROM concurrent

panels.title: Concurrency Rate
panels.description: Percentage of active selected-scope chatters who crossed into another channel within the overlap window.

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT
    event_time,
    channel_name,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), 'name:' || LOWER(NULLIF(user_name, ''))) AS chatter_key
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), NULLIF(user_name, '')) IS NOT NULL
), all_chatters AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT chatter_key FROM scoped
), concurrent AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.chatter_key
  FROM scoped a
  JOIN scoped b
    ON b.chatter_key = a.chatter_key
   AND b.channel_name <> a.channel_name
   AND b.event_time >= a.event_time
   AND b.event_time <= a.event_time + INTERVAL '${overlap_minutes} minutes'
)
SELECT ROUND((100.0 * COUNT(concurrent.chatter_key) / NULLIF(COUNT(all_chatters.chatter_key), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Concurrency rate"
FROM all_chatters
LEFT JOIN concurrent USING (chatter_key)

panels.title: Peak Concurrent Chatters
panels.description: Highest count of distinct concurrent chatters in any Grafana time bucket.

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT id, event_time, channel_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), 'name:' || LOWER(NULLIF(user_name, ''))) AS chatter_key
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), NULLIF(user_name, '')) IS NOT NULL
), overlap_events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.chatter_key, LEAST(a.event_time, b.event_time) AS overlap_time
  FROM scoped a
  JOIN scoped b
    ON b.chatter_key = a.chatter_key
   AND b.channel_name <> a.channel_name
   AND (b.event_time, b.id) > (a.event_time, a.id)
   AND b.event_time <= a.event_time + INTERVAL '${overlap_minutes} minutes'
), bucketed AS (
  SELECT $__timeGroup(overlap_time, $__interval) AS bucket, COUNT(DISTINCT chatter_key) AS concurrent_chatters
  FROM overlap_events
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(concurrent_chatters), 0) AS "Peak concurrent chatters"
FROM bucketed

panels.title: Average Channels per Concurrent Chatter
panels.description: Mean number of selected channels touched by each chatter with at least one concurrent overlap.

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT event_time, channel_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), 'name:' || LOWER(NULLIF(user_name, ''))) AS chatter_key
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), NULLIF(user_name, '')) IS NOT NULL
), concurrent AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.chatter_key
  FROM scoped a
  JOIN scoped b
    ON b.chatter_key = a.chatter_key
   AND b.channel_name <> a.channel_name
   AND b.event_time >= a.event_time
   AND b.event_time <= a.event_time + INTERVAL '${overlap_minutes} minutes'
), channel_counts AS (
  SELECT chatter_key, COUNT(DISTINCT channel_name) AS channels
  FROM scoped
  WHERE chatter_key IN (SELECT chatter_key FROM concurrent)
  GROUP BY chatter_key
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(channels)::numeric, 2) AS "Average channels"
FROM channel_counts

panels.title: Channel-Pair Overlap Matrix
panels.description: Symmetric channel-pair view of distinct chatters who were active in both channels within the overlap window.

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT id, event_time, channel_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), 'name:' || LOWER(NULLIF(user_name, ''))) AS chatter_key
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), NULLIF(user_name, '')) IS NOT NULL
), pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.chatter_key, LEAST(a.channel_name, b.channel_name) AS channel_a, GREATEST(a.channel_name, b.channel_name) AS channel_b
  FROM scoped a
  JOIN scoped b
    ON b.chatter_key = a.chatter_key
   AND b.channel_name <> a.channel_name
   AND (b.event_time, b.id) > (a.event_time, a.id)
   AND b.event_time <= a.event_time + INTERVAL '${overlap_minutes} minutes'
), audience AS (
  SELECT channel_name, COUNT(DISTINCT chatter_key) AS audience
  FROM scoped
  GROUP BY channel_name
), pair_counts AS (
  SELECT channel_a, channel_b, COUNT(*) AS concurrent_chatters
  FROM pairs
  GROUP BY channel_a, channel_b
)
SELECT
  channel_a AS "Channel A",
  channel_b AS "Channel B",
  concurrent_chatters AS "Concurrent chatters",
  ROUND((100.0 * concurrent_chatters / NULLIF(LEAST(audience_a.audience, audience_b.audience), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Overlap of smaller audience %",
  ROUND((100.0 * concurrent_chatters / NULLIF(audience_a.audience + audience_b.audience - concurrent_chatters, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Jaccard %"
FROM pair_counts
JOIN audience audience_a ON audience_a.channel_name = channel_a
JOIN audience audience_b ON audience_b.channel_name = channel_b
ORDER BY concurrent_chatters DESC, channel_a, channel_b
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Concurrent-Audience Network
panels.description: Channel nodes connected by users who were active in both channels within the overlap window.

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT id, event_time, channel_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), 'name:' || LOWER(NULLIF(user_name, ''))) AS chatter_key
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), NULLIF(user_name, '')) IS NOT NULL
), pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.chatter_key, LEAST(a.channel_name, b.channel_name) AS source, GREATEST(a.channel_name, b.channel_name) AS target
  FROM scoped a
  JOIN scoped b
    ON b.chatter_key = a.chatter_key
   AND b.channel_name <> a.channel_name
   AND (b.event_time, b.id) > (a.event_time, a.id)
   AND b.event_time <= a.event_time + INTERVAL '${overlap_minutes} minutes'
), pair_counts AS (
  SELECT source, target, COUNT(*) AS shared_chatters
  FROM pairs
  GROUP BY source, target
), audience AS (
  SELECT channel_name, COUNT(DISTINCT chatter_key) AS audience
  FROM scoped
  GROUP BY channel_name
)
SELECT
  source || ' -> ' || target AS id,
  source,
  target,
  shared_chatters::text || ' concurrent' AS "mainStat",
  ROUND((100.0 * shared_chatters / NULLIF(audience_a.audience + audience_b.audience - shared_chatters, 0))::numeric, 1)::text || '%' AS "secondaryStat",
  ROUND((1.0 + 9.0 * shared_chatters / NULLIF(LEAST(audience_a.audience, audience_b.audience), 0))::numeric, 2) AS thickness
FROM pair_counts
JOIN audience audience_a ON audience_a.channel_name = source
JOIN audience audience_b ON audience_b.channel_name = target
ORDER BY shared_chatters DESC, source, target
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Channel Concurrency Fingerprint
panels.description: For each channel, classify active chatters as solo-only, two-channel, or three-plus-channel participants based on observed concurrent overlaps.

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT event_time, channel_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), 'name:' || LOWER(NULLIF(user_name, ''))) AS chatter_key
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), NULLIF(user_name, '')) IS NOT NULL
), active_memberships AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT chatter_key, channel_name FROM scoped
), concurrent_memberships AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.chatter_key, a.channel_name
  FROM scoped a
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM scoped b
    WHERE b.chatter_key = a.chatter_key
      AND b.channel_name <> a.channel_name
      AND b.event_time BETWEEN a.event_time - INTERVAL '${overlap_minutes} minutes'
                           AND a.event_time + INTERVAL '${overlap_minutes} minutes'
  )
), concurrent_degrees AS (
  SELECT chatter_key, COUNT(*) AS concurrent_channels
  FROM concurrent_memberships
  GROUP BY chatter_key
)
SELECT
  active_memberships.channel_name AS "Channel",
  CASE
    WHEN concurrent_degrees.chatter_key IS NULL THEN 'Solo only'
    WHEN concurrent_degrees.concurrent_channels = 2 THEN 'Two-channel'
    ELSE 'Three+ channels'
  END AS "Concurrency mode",
  COUNT(*) AS "Chatters"
FROM active_memberships
LEFT JOIN concurrent_degrees USING (chatter_key)
GROUP BY active_memberships.channel_name, 2
ORDER BY active_memberships.channel_name, 2

panels.title: Bridge-Chatters
panels.description: Chatters who create concurrent links between the most channel pairs.

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT id, event_time, channel_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), 'name:' || LOWER(NULLIF(user_name, ''))) AS chatter_key, COALESCE(NULLIF(display_name, ''), NULLIF(user_name, ''), NULLIF(user_id, '')) AS chatter
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), NULLIF(user_name, '')) IS NOT NULL
), pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.chatter_key, LEAST(a.channel_name, b.channel_name) AS channel_a, GREATEST(a.channel_name, b.channel_name) AS channel_b
  FROM scoped a
  JOIN scoped b
    ON b.chatter_key = a.chatter_key
   AND b.channel_name <> a.channel_name
   AND (b.event_time, b.id) > (a.event_time, a.id)
   AND b.event_time <= a.event_time + INTERVAL '${overlap_minutes} minutes'
), bridge_stats AS (
  SELECT chatter_key, COUNT(*) AS connected_pairs, COUNT(DISTINCT channel_a) + COUNT(DISTINCT channel_b) AS pair_endpoints
  FROM pairs
  GROUP BY chatter_key
), message_stats AS (
  SELECT chatter_key, MAX(chatter) AS chatter, COUNT(*) AS messages, COUNT(DISTINCT channel_name) AS channels
  FROM scoped
  GROUP BY chatter_key
)
SELECT message_stats.chatter AS "Chatter", message_stats.channels AS "Channels", bridge_stats.connected_pairs AS "Connected pairs", message_stats.messages AS "Messages"
FROM bridge_stats
JOIN message_stats USING (chatter_key)
ORDER BY "Connected pairs" DESC, "Channels" DESC, "Messages" DESC, "Chatter"
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Multitasking Leaderboard
panels.description: A playful ranking of concurrent channel breadth, overlap links, message volume, and a normalized multitasking score.

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT id, event_time, channel_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), 'name:' || LOWER(NULLIF(user_name, ''))) AS chatter_key, COALESCE(NULLIF(display_name, ''), NULLIF(user_name, ''), NULLIF(user_id, '')) AS chatter
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), NULLIF(user_name, '')) IS NOT NULL
), pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.chatter_key, LEAST(a.channel_name, b.channel_name) AS channel_a, GREATEST(a.channel_name, b.channel_name) AS channel_b
  FROM scoped a
  JOIN scoped b
    ON b.chatter_key = a.chatter_key
   AND b.channel_name <> a.channel_name
   AND (b.event_time, b.id) > (a.event_time, a.id)
   AND b.event_time <= a.event_time + INTERVAL '${overlap_minutes} minutes'
), pair_stats AS (
  SELECT chatter_key, COUNT(*) AS concurrent_pairs
  FROM pairs
  GROUP BY chatter_key
), message_stats AS (
  SELECT chatter_key, MAX(chatter) AS chatter, COUNT(*) AS messages, COUNT(DISTINCT channel_name) AS channels
  FROM scoped
  GROUP BY chatter_key
)
SELECT
  message_stats.chatter AS "Chatter",
  message_stats.channels AS "Channels",
  pair_stats.concurrent_pairs AS "Concurrent pairs",
  message_stats.messages AS "Messages",
  ROUND((pair_stats.concurrent_pairs::numeric * message_stats.channels / NULLIF(message_stats.messages, 0)), 3) AS "Multitasking score"
FROM pair_stats
JOIN message_stats USING (chatter_key)
ORDER BY "Multitasking score" DESC, "Concurrent pairs" DESC, "Messages" DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Attention Split
panels.description: For concurrent chatters, compare the busiest channel’s message share with all side-channel activity.

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT event_time, channel_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), 'name:' || LOWER(NULLIF(user_name, ''))) AS chatter_key, COALESCE(NULLIF(display_name, ''), NULLIF(user_name, ''), NULLIF(user_id, '')) AS chatter
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), NULLIF(user_name, '')) IS NOT NULL
), concurrent AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.chatter_key
  FROM scoped a
  JOIN scoped b
    ON b.chatter_key = a.chatter_key
   AND b.channel_name <> a.channel_name
   AND b.event_time >= a.event_time
   AND b.event_time <= a.event_time + INTERVAL '${overlap_minutes} minutes'
), per_channel AS (
  SELECT s.chatter_key, MAX(s.chatter) AS chatter, s.channel_name, COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM scoped s
  JOIN concurrent c USING (chatter_key)
  GROUP BY s.chatter_key, s.channel_name
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY chatter_key ORDER BY messages DESC, channel_name) AS channel_rank, SUM(messages) OVER (PARTITION BY chatter_key) AS total_messages
  FROM per_channel
), attention AS (
  SELECT chatter_key, MAX(chatter) AS chatter, MAX(messages) FILTER (WHERE channel_rank = 1) AS primary_messages, MAX(total_messages) AS total_messages, MAX(channel_name) FILTER (WHERE channel_rank = 1) AS primary_channel
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY chatter_key
)
SELECT primary_channel AS "Primary channel", ROUND(AVG(100.0 * primary_messages / NULLIF(total_messages, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Primary-channel share", ROUND(AVG(100.0 - 100.0 * primary_messages / NULLIF(total_messages, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Side-channel share"
FROM attention
GROUP BY primary_channel
ORDER BY "Side-channel share" DESC, primary_channel

panels.title: Switching Latency by Channel Pair
panels.description: Average time between messages in different channels when the second message falls inside the overlap window.

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT id, event_time, channel_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), 'name:' || LOWER(NULLIF(user_name, ''))) AS chatter_key
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), NULLIF(user_name, '')) IS NOT NULL
), switches AS (
  SELECT a.chatter_key, a.channel_name AS from_channel, b.channel_name AS to_channel, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (b.event_time - a.event_time)) / 60.0 AS latency_minutes
  FROM scoped a
  JOIN scoped b
    ON b.chatter_key = a.chatter_key
   AND b.channel_name <> a.channel_name
   AND (b.event_time, b.id) > (a.event_time, a.id)
   AND b.event_time <= a.event_time + INTERVAL '${overlap_minutes} minutes'
)
SELECT from_channel || ' → ' || to_channel AS "Channel switch", ROUND(AVG(latency_minutes)::numeric, 2) AS "Average latency", COUNT(DISTINCT chatter_key) AS "Chatters"
FROM switches
GROUP BY from_channel, to_channel
ORDER BY "Average latency", "Chatters" DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Synchronized-Burst Timeline
panels.description: Distinct chatters producing cross-channel overlap events, grouped by channel pair and Grafana's adaptive time interval.

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT id, event_time, channel_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), 'name:' || LOWER(NULLIF(user_name, ''))) AS chatter_key
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), NULLIF(user_name, '')) IS NOT NULL
), overlap_events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.chatter_key, LEAST(a.channel_name, b.channel_name) || ' ↔ ' || GREATEST(a.channel_name, b.channel_name) AS pair, LEAST(a.event_time, b.event_time) AS overlap_time
  FROM scoped a
  JOIN scoped b
    ON b.chatter_key = a.chatter_key
   AND b.channel_name <> a.channel_name
   AND (b.event_time, b.id) > (a.event_time, a.id)
   AND b.event_time <= a.event_time + INTERVAL '${overlap_minutes} minutes'
)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(overlap_time, $__interval), pair AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT chatter_key) AS value
FROM overlap_events
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2
